modules.name: 质控与标准化
modules.desc: 原始表达矩阵的细胞/基因检出、线粒体比例与标准化后总计数，建立 21 物种可比的上游质控基线。

modules.name: 高变基因
modules.desc: 每个物种筛选 3,000 个批次感知高变基因，用于后续降维与聚类。

modules.name: PCA 降维
modules.desc: 代表细胞上的 50 维稀疏 PCA，展示方差解释与 PC1/PC2 结构。

modules.name: Harmony 批次校正
modules.desc: 按器官内文库进行 Harmony 批次校正，并投影到全图谱，比较校正前后嵌入与批次效应。

modules.name: 近邻图
modules.desc: 在 50 维 Harmony 空间构建 k=30 近邻图，检查同器官邻域保留与图结构。

modules.name: UMAP 与 Leiden 聚类
modules.desc: 基于近邻图计算全细胞 UMAP，并进行 Leiden 多分辨率聚类与分辨率诊断。

modules.name: Marker 与细胞注释
modules.desc: Marker 检测、分辨率评估与最终细胞类型注释，包含每物种 marker 点图与注释 UMAP。

modules.name: 细胞组成
modules.desc: 物种、器官与细胞类型层面的细胞组成，以及跨物种细胞类型相关性。

modules.name: 细胞类型 DEG 与富集
modules.desc: 细胞类型差异表达、marker 特异性、GO/KEGG 富集与跨物种直系同源群比较。

categories.name: 直系同源群特异性状态

modules.name: 拟时序与轨迹参考
modules.desc: 伪时序/轨迹参考分析：谱系结构、已知基因动态与工具一致性；作为虚拟细胞轨迹的先验参考。

modules.name: 基因调控网络
modules.desc: pySCENIC regulon、共表达模块、hub TF、RSS 排序与 CellOracle 虚拟敲除。

modules.name: 细胞通讯
modules.desc: LIANA + CellChat v2 的配体-受体推断、通路网络、NMF 模式与跨物种保守性；结果为计算推断。

categories.name: 4. cell type x cell type heatmaps
NMF 模式与 rank 选择

modules.name: 细胞状态与生态型
modules.desc: 细胞状态与生态型（EcoTyper）分析：状态分布、标志基因、共现、稳定性、样本得分、功能富集与跨物种相似性。

categories.name: 细胞状态标志基因热图
各细胞类型内部的状态比例分布
生态型得分在样本间的分布
跨细胞类型的状态共现热图
生态型重抽样稳定性与置换检验
数据覆盖、状态数量与生态型数量概览
样本条件关联与差异效应量
生态型得分与测序深度、检出基因数关联
留出样本中的状态恢复评估

modules.name: bulk 反卷积
modules.desc: 用单细胞图谱反卷积干旱/对照 bulk 数据，评估细胞类型组成变化与归因。

figures.title: 通路中心性热图 · 第1部分
figures.caption: CellChat network centrality, landscape part 1/3; seven species per plate. The three plates retain all 33 analyzed datasets across 21 species. Node-cell metadata and CellChat inference are unchanged. Bilingual species-organ labels 44 pt, pathway labels 36 pt and cell-type labels 40 pt bold. [OG] abbreviates the original OG-description suffix; complete original keys and raw centrality scores are retained in the source table. Kiwifruit and peanut have supported entries in this standalone CellChat analysis; their zero results under the separate dual-method LIANA criterion are not substituted here. Exploratory expression-supported candidate networks, including curated signals and gene/annotation groups; network direction and centrality do not establish a causal intercellular mechanism.

This replaces the original independently scaled per-panel dot sizes without changing any scores or selected dots. [OG] shortens OG-description names; complete names remain in the source data. Cell and signaling labels are 56 pt bold; bilingual panel titles are 64/60 pt. NMF and communication inference were not rerun. PNG 120 dpi; PDF/SVG retain editable vector text. figures.category: NMF 模式与 rank 选择
figures.title: NMF 模式与 rank 选择 · 第1部分
figures.caption: NMF communication-pattern rank selection, landscape part 1/2 (15 original datasets). All 30 dataset plots and all selected ranks are retained, with 15 datasets in part 1 and 15 in part 2. Each bilingual species-organ panel has incoming (left) and outgoing (right) rank surveys. X axis: tested integer ranks k; Y axis: original cophenetic coefficient and consensus silhouette coefficient. Purple solid circles: cophenetic; teal dashed diamonds: silhouette; gold stars and the printed k indicate the selected rank. Both directions share a Y scale within a dataset; Y scales are independent across datasets. Coincident curves are retained without jitter, using different line styles and marker sizes. Original estimates used 30 NMF runs per k, Lee algorithm, seed 10; k is selected immediately before the first cophenetic decrease exceeding 0.02, or, if no such decrease occurs, by the maximum sum of cophenetic and silhouette coefficients. Saved choices are used directly, including choices whose differences round to ties in the exported scores. These are parameter-selection diagnostics, not communication strength, statistical-significance tests or biological pathway counts. Part 2 includes an eligibility card: Grape leaf 3 cell types; Kiwifruit leaf, Peanut leaf 2 cell types, below the four-type NMF requirement. Quantitative plots cover 18 species, with 3 additional species explicitly accounted for in the status card, representing all 21 species. Fonts: species-organ titles 42 pt, direction labels 34 pt, axis labels and shared legend 32 pt, ticks 28 pt. Source scores, tested k and selected k are unchanged; NMF was not rerun.

figures.caption: Outgoing NMF river diagrams, landscape part 1/2 (15 datasets). All 30 original datasets, chosen ranks, membership contributions and original signal names are retained. Entity labels have reserved vertical slots and do not encode weight by their spacing. figures.title: 组织相邻性检验
figures.caption: Spatial plausibility: number of significant interactions (both directions, extracellular-plausible classes, z-scored within the dataset) for anatomically adjacent vs non-adjacent cell-type pairs (tissue_adjacency.tsv; meristematic cells and uncertain pairs excluded; self pairs excluded). Bars: means. P: one-sided permutation of the adjacency labels among the cell-type pairs (10,000), per dataset and pooled. Adjacency was not used to select interactions. Exploratory: cells are not independent replicates; inferred interactions are expression-based and are not evidence of causal or spatial interaction.

figures.title: 下游响应
figures.caption: Downstream target expression support for all 21 species and 33 datasets (primary results). Orange: statistically supported inferred interactions; grey: detected controls without inference support. Support uses the primary dual-method significance rule. Downstream support: >=10 expressed targets of TFs within two STRING edges of the receptor (score>=700, orthogroup transfer) and PlantRegMap target-expression z statistic>1.645 in the receiver. n in row labels is the number of testable statistically supported interactions, not cells or libraries. Rows with n=0 have NA rather than a zero support fraction; available control fractions remain plotted. No minimum-20 plotting filter is applied. Fold labels are support-fraction ratios; P: one-sided Fisher exact test. The all-datasets row and dataset-stratified CMH statistics are recomputed from the combined score table; only non-degenerate strata enter the CMH test. Exploratory: cells are not independent replicates; inferred interactions are expression-based and are not evidence of causal or spatial interaction.

figures.title: bulk 样本与单细胞参考 · 跨物种
figures.caption: Bulk samples matched to single-cell references and the cell types of each reference. Left: control and drought samples per reference (organ from public metadata, checked by expression); numbers are BioProjects. Right: eligible cell types; marker size is the type's RNA share in the atlas; outlined markers passed the pre-set simulation reliability rule with the primary method.

figures.title: 反卷积模拟精度 · 跨物种
figures.caption: Accuracy of deconvolution on pseudobulk mixtures built from held-out single-cell data. Left: RMSE of the estimated RNA fractions per reference and method (platform noise σ = 0.5; both proportion designs); * references validated on held-out libraries of one study (others: held-out studies). Right: per-type Pearson r between true and estimated fractions for the primary method; outlined squares passed the reliability rule (r ≥ 0.7, RMSE ≤ 0.10, |bias| ≤ 0.05, ≥ 10 markers).

figures.title: 扰动检验 · 跨物种
figures.caption: What a cell-type-specific expression change does to the deconvolution (pseudobulk; 200 genes of one type × 3 in one of two groups with the same proportion distribution; NNLS). Left: shift of the perturbed type's estimated RNA fraction. Right: fraction of perturbed genes whose change is attributed to the perturbed type, minus chance (1/K, K = types of the reference), by posterior Z (largest absolute change) and by an interaction regression; uniform: Dirichlet(1) proportions, atlas-like: Dirichlet(10 × atlas share). One point per reference × fold × perturbed type.

figures.title: bulk 细胞组成 · 跨物种
figures.caption: Estimated cell-type RNA composition of the bulk samples (NNLS). Left: mean RNA fraction per reference and condition (low-fit samples excluded). Right: Pearson r between observed and reconstructed log2(CPM + 1) over the signature genes; red points: low-fit samples (below median − 3 MAD), excluded from the drought analysis.

figures.title: 干旱细胞组成 · 跨物种
figures.caption: Drought-associated change of cell-type RNA composition (NNLS; reliable types only). Left: all references of the same organ pooled; diamonds filled when BH q < 0.05. Right: per reference (number of BioProjects in brackets) and cell type, the DerSimonian–Laird pooled within-BioProject difference of centred log-ratio RNA fractions; outlined: q < 0.05. †: robust, i.e. q < 0.05 also with the drought-robust signature and the same sign in every sensitivity variant. Effects are relative to the other types of the same reference.

figures.title: 细胞类型归因 · 跨物种
figures.caption: Cell-type view of the bulk drought response. Left: enrichment of reference cell types among the dominant expressing types of drought-up and drought-down genes (meta-analysis across BioProjects, q < 0.05, |log2FC| ≥ 1; dominant type: largest share of the gene's expected expression, share ≥ 0.5); colour: log2 odds ratio against the 5,000 tested genes; outlined: BH q < 0.05; size: genes. Right: per reference, BioProject × type pairs in which a synthetic type-specific change (spike-in on bulk simulated from the project's own estimated proportions) was attributed to the right type by the interaction regression (recovery ≥ max(0.5, (1 + 1/K)/2) and the type absorbing other types' changes no more than chance).
